In the outer ring are the legends "Bhumibol Adulyadej" on the left and "The Ninth Reign" on the right. Reverse: The reverse shows the Central Prang of Arun Ratchawararam Temple (Temple of the Dawn). Around the outer ring are the legends "Thailand", the year of issue and the denomination "10 baht" in Braille above and in Thai and Arabic numerals below.

On the top border are the legends "Thailand" and the year of issue, and at the bottom "5 baht" in Thai and Arabic numerals.

A dotted pattern surrounds the outer border. **Reverse:** In the center is Phra Borom Banphot (The Golden Mount Stupa) of Saket Temple, Bangkok. The upper border is inscribed with "Thailand" and the year of issue. At the bottom is the denomination "2 baht" in Thai and Arabic numerals. A dotted pattern surrounds the outer border.
